# Edmund Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Edmund features straight black hair, well-shaped features, and large, deep gray eyes that express a range of intense emotions. He is regarded as the most handsome child at Hollowmere, though he bears no family resemblance to any recognized relatives.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013)_

## Personality

Edmund is imaginative, theatrical, and absent-minded, often becoming lost in reveries or consumed by a deep love of poetry and beauty. Although he possesses a shy, reserved exterior and lacks physical strength, he is easily humiliated and detests fighting or seeing anyone in pain. He exhibits a strong sense of duty, taking personal responsibility for mishaps and showing bravery when defending his loved ones. He also delights in manipulating the emotions of his companions with dramatic stories and thoroughly enjoys ghost tales.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c8 P27](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0027), [v5 c11 P1](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0001), [v5 c12 P10](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0010), [v5 c12 P26](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0026), [v5 c13 P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002), [v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016), [v5 c17 P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041), [v5 c17 P57](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0057), [v5 c29 P8](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0008)_

## History

Edmund grew up at Hollowmere alongside his siblings, spending much of his time reading, retreat into quiet nature spots, and composing verses. He coined the name "Fern Hollow" for a local dale. Because he avoided school fights and sports to focus on books, his peers at Glen St. Agnes school regarded him as milk-soppish, though his distinct, preacher-like speech earned him some protection. He kept his epic poetry writing a secret shared only with his sister Izzy. Following a dare from Grace Ashdown, he rode a stray pig through the settlement and accepted the blame for the incident. When Dan Coyle insulted Edmund's mother and Grace, Edmund challenged Dan to a brawl despite his fear of violence, defeating Dan in the spruce plantation. After suffering from a severe toothache, he determined to travel to Kettlebridge to have the tooth pulled. He also spent time sailing around the harbour with Captain Crawford and Tobias Corcoran.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001), [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c3 P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 c12 P10](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0010), [v5 c12 P26](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0026), [v5 c16 P8](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0008), [v5 c17 P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 c17 P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041), [v5 c17 P43](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0043), [v5 c17 P57](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0057), [v5 c17 P71](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0071), [v5 c30 P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001)_
